summary: Direct extraction and inspection of the rebuilt NSIS installer, confirming the Phase 3.8.6.1 DLL-bundling fix still holds after this phase's additions (new tauri-plugin-dialog dependency, model-provisioning command, counter/build-metadata fixes), plus symbol-level proof that both the whisper feature and the new file-picker plugin are genuinely compiled into this exact binary.

installerChecksum.sizeIncreaseNote: Consistent with the new tauri-plugin-dialog/rfd dependency and the install_whisper_model command's additional code, despite NSIS LZMA compression.

runtimeDllsStillPresent.note: Byte SIZES are identical to Phase 3.8.6.1's recorded values (same source files, same toolchain, same strip flags) - confirming these are the same DLLs, unaffected by this phase. The SHA-256 VALUES differ from Phase 3.8.6.1's recorded ones, and this was investigated directly rather than assumed innocuous: `x86_64-w64-mingw32-strip --strip-debug` rewrites the PE COFF header's Time/Date field (and its dependent header CheckSum field) to the wall-clock time of the strip operation itself, confirmed by stripping the identical source file twice one second apart and diffing the objdump -p output - only the Time/Date and CheckSum fields differed (2 bytes total), the import table, export table, and all code sections were byte-identical. This means these DLLs' SHA-256 is NOT stable across rebuilds by construction, and is not a security-relevant discrepancy - it does not reflect any change to source, toolchain, or content.

cipDesktopExeVerification.buildCommitEmbeddedProof: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings finds the literal string '61c80a40' (this session's real current-HEAD short-12 commit hash at build time) embedded in the binary - direct evidence the build.rs rerun-if-changed fix (this phase) works: a build with no other apps/desktop/src-tauri file changed since the last commit still picked up the CURRENT git state, not a stale cached value.
cipDesktopExeVerification.whisperFeatureSymbolProof: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings finds whisper_full_with_state, ggml_backend_init, and other real whisper.cpp/ggml symbols - the whisper feature remains genuinely compiled in, unaffected by this phase's changes.
cipDesktopExeVerification.dialogPluginSymbolProof: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings finds tauri_plugin_dialog::init and tauri_plugin_dialog::desktop::pick_file mangled symbols - the new native file-picker capability this phase adds is genuinely compiled into this exact binary, not just declared as a dependency.
